title: feat: add user menu to home page, return-to-home nav in app sidebar
body:
Home page (`/home`) had no user menu (profile, sign out) and apps had no way to navigate back to home without editing the URL. ### HomeLayout shell (`HomeLayout.tsx` — new) - Sticky top nav bar wrapping `` with Home branding, Settings, and user menu dropdown (avatar → Profile / Settings / Sign Out) - Wired into `/home` route via lazy-loaded wrapper in `App.tsx` ### Return-to-Home in AppSidebar - Added "Home" entry with `Home` icon in the app switcher dropdown, navigating to `/home` ```tsx // AppSidebar.tsx — app switcher dropdown, after app list navigate('/home')} data-testid="home-link-btn">
Home
 ``` ### HomePage simplification - Removed duplicate header/nav since `HomeLayout` now owns it - Removed unused `resolveI18nLabel` import (pre-existing TS warning) ### Tests - 9 new unit tests for `HomeLayout` (rendering, navigation, avatar fallback) - All 11 existing `AppSidebar` tests pass unchanged
